params.body:
The gateway never merges, so a proposal that nobody is told about waits. Today the
operator found his own agent's pull requests by opening the repository, because none of
them ever asked him to review.

The cause is a config key that was never written. In control, `requestReview(...)` returns
immediately when `Reviewer` is empty, and the config `ControlService::config()` writes to
`/home/elixir/control/config.json` has no `reviewer` key at all.

This adds it:

- `config/elixir.php`: `control_reviewer`, from `ELIXIR_CONTROL_REVIEWER`, default `ShaneDeconinck`.
- `ControlService::config()` writes it as `reviewer`.
- `ControlClientTest` pins that the written config names a reviewer, so the key cannot
  quietly disappear again.

After this merges the box redeploys within two minutes, but the VM carries its own copy of
the config, so it takes `scp elixir@167.233.221.164:control/config.json ~/control-config.json`,
then `rehearse.sh config ~/control-config.json` and `rehearse.sh reboot` to take effect.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Ask the operator to review what a hand proposes
